response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_avg AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity) AS distance_from_kept_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity) DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, above_overall_avg, distance_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref;

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means absolute distance from the mean of the kept equipment.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat the last difference as a signed deviation from the kept-equipment mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_avg AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, above_overall_avg, difference_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref;
